Posting is partly done: 47 of 50 invoices posted, and 3 were rejected by validation. I haven't overridden any of them.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| INV-1012 | Arden Tools | 4,210.00 | Duplicate of invoice number AT-5531, already posted as INV-0954 | Confirm it is a duplicate and leave it unposted or reject it. |
| INV-1027 | Brightline Freight | 18,400.00 | References PO-7781, which is closed | Have the PO reopened or a valid PO identified, then repost. |
| INV-1044 | Corvel Supply | 2,975.50 | Line 2 has no tax code | Get the correct tax code for line 2, then repost. |
